commands:
starbridge ask \
  --question "Use Sentry or self-hosted GlitchTip for web app error tracking?" \
  --context "Sentry: free to 5k errors/month, then \$26/month; session replay included; hosted, no upkeep.
GlitchTip: free, runs on our VPS; we patch and back it up ourselves (~1 hour/month).
Nothing is wired in until you choose." \
  --option "Sentry" --option "GlitchTip" --recommended "Sentry" --waiting
turns.final:
I've asked which service to use on a Starbridge card (`d_7d93UUmu37MeLdC5`), and I haven't wired anything in yet. `AskUserQuestion` was turned away here and pointed me to Starbridge, so I used that.

The card compares Sentry (free to 5k errors a month, then $26/month, session replay included) with self-hosted GlitchTip (free, but about an hour a month of patching and backups). I recommended Sentry. I'll wire in whichever you pick once your answer arrives.

decisions.question: Use Sentry or self-hosted GlitchTip for web app error tracking?
